universal_algebra.domain: all integers N>=0, 0<=q<=N; interior formulas use N>=3, 1<=q<=N-1; mu2 uses N>=4
universal_algebra.sign_reason: q,r>=1 imply (q-1)(r-1)>=0; squares>=0; N>=4 implies N-3>=1; 0<=rho<1 makes every plane-square coefficient nonnegative

sharp_slice_coefficients.comparison: S<=max(2*mu1/N,mu2/(N-1))*G for N>=4, 1<=q<=N-1; the zero-image coefficient may be omitted

universal_algebra.scope: exact symbolic identities plus the explicitly stated sign hypotheses; the all-graph implication is also checked by Lean, not inferred from these formulas alone

graph_probes.scope: all degree spaces on 0<=n<=5; additionally n=6 degrees all 1 or all 2

negative_single_interaction_not_a_refuta.meaning: allowed diagnostic; positivity is claimed only after the ordered sum

jacobian.binding: twice the Gram matrix of the three complementary equality-indicator classes on X_(4,2); nonzero spectrum equals the six-pair frame spectrum
